# Aditya Indra Bayu — Fractional CMO & Venture Builder

> Aditya (Andrew) Indra Bayu is a fractional CMO and venture builder based in South Tangerang, Indonesia. He plugs into founding teams as senior growth leadership without a full-time CMO cost. Across his career he has driven 300K+ qualified leads and $10M+ in client revenue for D2C and service brands, managing IDR 4B+ in ad budgets across Meta, Google, and TikTok — backed by a Clutch.co Top-100, Meta Marketing Partner team (We Are Infiniti / Calibreworks).

## What Aditya does
- Fractional CMO / Head of Growth for D2C and service brands
- Full-funnel performance marketing — Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads
- Growth systems, revenue engines, and marketing gamification
- Venture building — 10 ventures across 5 industries

## Proof points
- 300K+ qualified leads driven
- $10M+ client revenue driven
- IDR 4B+ ad budget managed
- Clutch.co Top-100 digital agencies (Web, Marketing, Branding)
- Meta Marketing Partner
